0022600028.text: The Utah Jazz (1-6, on a five-game losing streak, 14th in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 9th in the West, coming off a loss) in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting a 138-120 Dallas win for the Mavericks in Dallas on January 17.
